SECRET - NOT FOR PRESS PUBLICATION
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SPECIAL BRANCH
-:-:-
Intelligence Report
Political January 26, 1934.

Movement of Notables

To Nanking
Departed at 3 p.m. January 25 :-
Tsai Yuan-pei, member of the Supervisory Yuan.
From Nanking
Arrived at 11.50 p.m. January 25 :-
Chen Kyi, Chairman of the Fukien Provincial Government.
Arrived at 8 a.m. January 26 :-
Li Shih-cha, Vice Minister of Navy.

Chinese Bar Association - meeting

Fourteen members of the Chinese Bar Association held a
meeting in their office, 572 Rue Amiral Bayle, between 7 p.m.
and 9 p.m. January 25, and decided to convene a general meeting
on February 25 as well as to despatch a telegram urging the 4th
Plenary Session now being held at Nanking to devise definite
measures to strengthen national defence in various provinces
bordering on China Proper.

Anti-Fascist and Anti-Imperialist Propaganda

Copies of a coloured paper slip purporting to emanate from
the Western District Branch of the Shanghai Anti-Imperialist
League and dated December 30, were found scattered on Haiphong
Road near Ferry Road at 8.10 p.m. January 25. It contains
the following slogans :-
1. Oppose the "terrorist" policy of the Kuomintang Fascists in
arresting some 70 students and teachers !
2. Demand the immediate release of the whole body of students
under arrest !
3. Form a Support Committee, despatch a circular telegram, and
solicit contributions in support of the students in custody!
4. Kill the Fascist leader Chiang Kai-shek and other Fascist
bandits who sold Manchuria, Jehol, North China and East Charhar.
5. Oppose the invasion of East Charhar by the Japanese
Imperialists !
6. Struggle for freedom in speech, assembly, anti-Imperialist
movement, etc.
7. Let the students unite ! Let them save themselves !

Communist Propaganda - One arrest

At 7.45 p.m. January 25, the Municipal Police, at the
request of the Chinese Authorities, arrested a communist
suspect named Woo Kya-liang (吳家良) alias Lao Waung (老汪)
alias Wong Tsung (黃正) on Haining Road near Chapoo Road.
The accused, who is stated by the Shanghai Bureau of
Public Safety to be the Chief Secretary of the Kiangsu Provincial
Committee of the Chinese Communist Party, will appear before
Court on January 26 when an application for his extradition
will be made by the Chinese Authorities.

政治情报报告
1934年1月26日。

要员动态

前往南京
1月25日下午3时离沪：
蔡元培，监察院委员。
来自南京
1月25日晚11时50分抵沪：
陈仪，福建省政府主席。
1月26日上午8时抵沪：
李世甲，海军部次长。

上海律师公会 - 会议

1月25日晚7时至9时，上海律师公会十四名会员在该会办事处（贝勒路572号）举行会议，决定于2月25日召开全体大会，并拍发电报敦促正在南京举行的国民党四中全会制定具体措施，加强中国本土周边各省的国防。

反法西斯与反帝宣传

1月25日晚8时10分，在靠近斐伦路的海防路上，发现散落着若干彩色传单，声称出自上海反帝同盟西区支部，日期为12月30日。传单包含以下标语：
1. 反对国民党法西斯逮捕约70名师生之“恐怖”政策！
2. 要求立即释放所有被捕学生！
3. 成立后援会，散发通电，募集捐款以支持被拘禁的学生！
4. 杀死法西斯头子蒋介石及其他出卖满洲、热河、华北及察东的法西斯匪徒。
5. 反对日本帝国主义入侵察东！
6. 争取言论、集会、反帝运动等自由。
7. 让学生们团结起来！让他们自救！

共产主义宣传 - 逮捕一人

1月25日晚7时45分，应中国当局请求，市警在海宁路靠近乍浦路处逮捕了一名共产主义嫌疑分子吴家良（Woo Kya-liang），别名老汪（Lao Waung），别名黄正（Wong Tsung）。据上海市公安局称，被告系中国共产党江苏省委员会秘书长，将于1月26日出庭，届时中国当局将申请将其引渡。

page_data.en:
Political (2)        January 26, 1934.

Communist Propaganda Addressed to Foreign Troops in Shanghai

    Communist handbills printed in English and addressed to
"English and American Soldiers and Sailors" have recently been
disseminated in British and American Military Camps in the
Western District.    Like leaflets in Japanese and addressed to
members of the Naval Landing Party have also been distributed
in the vicinity of North Szechuen Road Extension.    This
literature, which purports to emanate from the Military
Committee of the Chinese Communist Party, is of the usual
nature, calling upon foreign troops to support the Soviet
Union and overthrow imperialism.
page_data.zh:
政治 (2)        1934年1月26日。

针对驻沪外国军队的共产主义宣传

    近期，在西区英美军营内散布了用英文印刷并致“英美士兵与水兵”的共产主义传单。同样，在四川北路延伸段附近也分发了用日文印刷并致海军陆战队成员的传单。这些文献声称出自中国共产党军事委员会，内容属常规性质，呼吁外国军队支持苏联并推翻帝国主义。

page_data.en:
Intelligence Report
Labour January 26, 1934.

Wei Foong Rubber Shoe Factory - operations suspended

The Wei Foong Rubber Shoe Factory which is located
at 215 Holung Road, suddenly closed down at 1 p.m. January 25,
affecting a total of 239 hands. It is believed that the
suspension was due to trade depression. The management did
not enlighten its employees as to the reason for the suspension
and it is learned that the Manager has absconded.

Shanghai Tug & Lighter Company - Strike called off

The 580 men of crews of the 102 lighters of the Wheelock
& Co., Contractor for the Shanghai Tug & Lighter Co. who declared
a strike on January 23, resumed work at 10 a.m. January 25 on
the management promising not to dismiss any strikers.
In connection with the fight on January 23 which resulted
in eight of the strikers and the followers of Nyi Wei Yang
(倪惠楊), the Chinese Chief Engineer of the Company, being
injured and one of the latter party drowned, the workers have
decided to bring the case before Court for a settlement. At
the same time, they are agitating for the dismissal of Nyi on
the ground that he employed a non-union member and was the prime
mover in the trouble.

Shanghai Radio Administration, 565 Mih Kuo Road, City -
employees' cooperative union holds meeting

Between 6 p.m. and 8 p.m. January 25, some eighty employees
of the Shanghai Radio Administration, 565 Min Kuo Road, City,
held a dinner party under the auspices of their Employees'
Cooperative Union, in the Koo Yih Sien (古益軒) Szechuen Restaurant,
204 Hankow Road. Matters pertaining to the work of the Union
were discussed at the meeting.
page_data.zh:
情报报告
劳工 1934年1月26日。

伟丰橡胶鞋厂 - 停工

位于霍龙路215号的伟丰橡胶鞋厂于1月25日下午1时突然关闭，共影响239名工人。据悉，停工原因是贸易萧条。资方未向员工说明停工原因，且获悉经理已潜逃。

上海拖轮驳船公司 - 罢工取消

上海拖轮驳船公司承包商惠罗公司的102艘驳船上的580名船员曾于1月23日宣布罢工，后因资方承诺不辞退任何罢工者，于1月25日上午10时复工。
关于1月23日的斗殴事件，导致八名罢工者及该公司华籍总工程师倪惠楊（Nyi Wei Yang）的追随者受伤，后者中有一人溺亡，工人们决定将此案诉诸法庭以求解决。同时，他们正鼓动解雇倪惠楊，理由是他雇佣了一名非工会成员，并且是此次纠纷的主要煽动者。

上海市无线电管理处，市中心民国路565号 -
员工合作联合会举行会议

1月25日晚6时至8时，市中心民国路565号上海市无线电管理处的约八十名员工，在其员工合作联合会的主持下，于汉口路204号古益轩川菜馆举行晚宴。会上讨论了有关联合会工作的事项。

page_data.en:
January 26, 1934.

Miscellaneous

Price of Rice

The wholesale price of Chinese Rice ranges from $6.60
to $7.80 per picul this morning and the retail prices quoted
by local rice shops are as follows :-

| | Chinese Rice | Saigon Rice |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Best Quality ... | $8.00 | $7.50 |
| Good " ... | $7.40 | $7.00 |
| Ordinary " ... | $6.80 | $6.50 |

Hot Water Shops in Eastern District - to increase

It is learned that the proprietors of hot water shops
situated between Lay Road and Chusan Road will hold a dinner
party on January 29 in the Hwa Ping (華平) Restaurant,
No.558-60-62 Pingliang Road, to decide the question of
increasing the charges for hot water. The office of these shop
owners at No.352 Pingliang Road has prepared a notice announcing
to the public an increase of 40% to 50% in the charges for hot
water supplied.

Chinese Cigarette Factory Owners - to demand relief

Some twenty Chinese who claimed to be cigarette factory
owners held a tea-party in the Central Restaurant, 330 Foochow
Road, between 2 p.m. and 3.30 p.m. January 25. Oo Ting-sung
(鄔挺生), a committee member of the Chinese Cigarette
Factory Owners' Association, No.72 Ziang Kang Li, Lyburgh Road,
who presided over the function, reported that in view of trade
depression, the Ministry of Finance which was requested to
arrange a loan of $500,000.00 for the relief of cigarette
factories in Shanghai, had promised to appropriate $300,000.00
for this purpose. It was eventually decided to ask the Ministry
to hand the money over to the Association without delay.

Residents in Tung Hai Li, Tungchow Road - oppose
disconnection of water supply

Some thirty tenants of the houses of the Tung Hai Li
(通海里), Tung Chow Road, held a meeting in House No.23 in
the Alleyway, between 3 p.m. and 4 p.m. January 25 and decided
that should the landlord fail to have the water supply to the
alleyway, which was disconnected on December 19, 1933 (Vide I.R.
21/12/33) reconnected in the near future, the residents be
instructed to withhold payment of rentals.
These residents were requested by the landlord to pay
$4.00 per month extra as water charges as from October 1, 1933.
The tenants however refused to comply with the request on the
ground that water charges are included in the rent and should
therefore be defrayed by the landlord. They are at present
using water from street hydrants.

H. V. Robertson
Superintendent
for Officer i/c Special Branch.
page_data.zh:
1934年1月26日。

杂项

米价

今晨国产大米批发价为每担6.60元至7.80元，本地米店零售报价如下：

| | 国产米 | 西贡米 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 上等 ... | 8.00元 | 7.50元 |
| 中等 " ... | 7.40元 | 7.00元 |
| 普通 " ... | 6.80元 | 6.50元 |

东区热水店 - 拟涨价

据悉，位于雷士德路与舟山路之间的热水店店主将于1月29日在平凉路558-60-62号华平饭店举行晚宴，以决定提高热水收费事宜。这些店主位于平凉路352号的办事处已拟定公告，向公众宣布热水供应费用将增加40%至50%。

华商卷烟厂主 - 要求救济

1月25日下午2时至3时30分，约二十名自称卷烟厂主的华人在福州路330号中央饭店举行茶话会。礼查路祥康里72号华商卷烟厂主协会委员鄔挺生（Oo Ting-sung）主持了此次活动，他报告称，鉴于贸易萧条，财政部曾受请安排贷款500,000.00元以救济上海卷烟厂，现已承诺拨款300,000.00元用于此目的。最终决定要求财政部立即将该笔款项移交给协会。

通州路通海里居民 - 反对断水

1月25日下午3时至4时，通州路通海里（Tung Hai Li）弄堂内的约三十名租户在弄堂23号房屋内举行会议，并决定若房东未能尽快重新接通于1933年12月19日切断的弄堂供水（见1933年12月21日情报报告），则指示居民拒付租金。
房东要求这些居民自1933年10月1日起每月额外支付4.00元作为水费。然而，租户以水费已包含在租金内、应由房东承担为由，拒绝 comply with 该要求。目前他们使用街道消防栓的水。

H. V. Robertson
警司
代特科主管警官。

SECRET - NOT FOR PRESS PUBLICATION

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SPECIAL BRANCH
February 1, 1934.
INTELLIGENCE REPORT
Political

Movement of Notables
To Nanking
Departed at 12 m.n. January 31/February 1 :-
Ma Tsao-tsing, member of the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang.
From Nanking
Arrived at 8 a.m. February 1 :-
Huang Shao-yung, Minister of Interior.
Chen Tsai, member of the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang.
To Hangchow
Departed at 9.30 a.m. January 31 by road :-
Marshal Chang Hsueh-liang.
General Chiang Kai-shek arrived at Chenju Station from
Nanking at 12.20 a.m. February 1 and left for Hangchow by road
at 3 a.m.

Communist Propaganda - Prosecutions

The seven persons arrested by the Municipal Police during
the night of January 26/27, 1934 on a charge of propagating
communism (Vide I.R. 27/1/34) appeared on remand before the
Second Branch Kiangsu High Court on January 31 when they were
ordered to be extradited to the Chinese Authorities.

........
Labour

Unloading of rice on Soochow Creek - resumed

The unloading of rice from boats on the Soochow Creek
is normal this morning, February 1.
At 10 a.m. January 31, the Chapei Rice Dealers' Association
held an urgent meeting in its office, 212 Kulung Road, Chapei,
when some 100 Chinese including representatives from the Bureau
of Public Safety attended. The disturbances by the rice porters
were discussed and on advice given by the delegates of the Public
Safety Bureau, it was decided to resume business on the following
conditions pending a settlement of the dispute by the Authorities:-
1. That the Chapei Police render protection.
2. That the Bureau of Public Safety notify the S.M.P. to give
protection to wheelbarrow coolies transporting rice to the
Settlement.
This decision resulted in 33 Rice Hongs on Kwang Foh Road
near the Stone Bridge which suspended business on January 30,
resuming operations at 11.30 a.m. January 31 under the protection
of some 40 constables of the Bureau of Public Safety.
At 10 a.m. January 31, the Bureau of Social Affairs
issued a notice to the coolies concerned warning them against
creating further disturbance. The notice further states that
the Bureau is arranging to secure work for the porters in
various rice hongs.

1934年2月1日。
情报报告
政治

要员动态

前往南京
1月31日午夜/2月1日凌晨离沪：
马超俊，国民党中央执行委员会委员。
来自南京
2月1日上午8时抵沪：
黄绍竑，内政部部长。
陈策，国民党中央执行委员会委员。
前往杭州
1月31日上午9时30分由陆路离沪：
张学良元帅。
蒋介石将军于2月1日凌晨12时20分从南京抵达真茹站，并于凌晨3时由陆路前往杭州。

共产主义宣传 - 起诉

1934年1月26/27日夜间因传播共产主义罪名被市警逮捕的七人（见1934年1月27日情报报告），于1月31日在江苏高等法院第二分院提审，并被命令引渡给中国当局 ____
劳工

苏州河卸米作业 - 恢复

2月1日上午，苏州河船只卸米作业恢复正常。
1月31日上午10时，闸北米业同业公会在其办事处（闸北固隆路212号）举行紧急会议，约有100名华人出席，其中包括公安局代表。会上讨论了米夫骚乱问题，并根据公安局代表的建议，决定在当局解决纠纷之前，按以下条件恢复营业：
1. 由闸北警方提供保护。
2. 由公安局通知市警，对运送大米进入租界的手推车苦力提供保护。
这一决定使得1月30日停业的广福路石桥附近的33家米行，在约40名公安局巡警的保护下，于1月31日上午11时30分恢复运营。
1月31日上午10时，社会局向相关苦力发布公告，警告他们不得再制造骚乱。公告还指出，社会局正在安排各米行为这些搬运工提供工作。

page_data.en:
Intelligence Report
Labour (2) February 1, 1934.

Silver Smiths in Chinese Territory - "tai-kung" strike continues

The "tai-kung" strike situation in various silver smith shops in Nantso and Chapei remains unchanged this morning, February 1.
In the evening of January 30, some eight members of the Investigation Corps formed by the "Tai-Kung" Strike Committee entered the Sung Fing Kee (孫炳記) and Wong Yung Zai (王榮才) Silver Smith Shops on Jen Miao Road and Ling Ying Road, Nantso, respectively, and smashed some furniture because they alleged the apprentices in these concerns were carrying on operations in secret. The assistance of the Chinese Police was called but the intruders fled before their arrival on the scene.
Six members of the "Tai-kung" Strike Committee held a meeting in the Silver Smiths' Union at 59 Tsih Zoen Sz Loong, City, between 1.30 p.m. and 3 p.m. January 31, and passed the following resolutions:
1. That the local Kuomintang and the Bureau of Social Affairs be further requested to bring about a satisfactory settlement of the dispute.
2. That all members be notified to remain in Shanghai during the period of the "Tai-kung" strike.
3. That the Sung Fing Kee and Wong Yung Zai Shops be warned against further attempts to break the "tai-kung" strike, and that they be held responsible for losses sustained by the Union.

Shanghai Dock & Engineering Co. - Pootung Engine Works and Shipyard - Unrest removed

In compliance with the request of the workers of the Pootung Engine Works and Shipyard of the Shanghai Dock & Engineering Company, delegates of the Bureau of Social Affairs, the General Labour Union, and representatives of the 5th District Ship-Building Trade Union at Pootung, negotiated with representatives of the management in the morning of January 31 over the renewal of the agreement governing the terms of service of employees (Vide I.R. 19/1/34). It was finally decided that with the exception of the term relating to increase of wages, the present agreement be continued for one year. The management was of the opinion that an increase in wages could not be granted to their employees until business improves.

General Labour Union - to convene meeting of representatives of local labour unions - oppose change of name

The General Labour Union, 117 Dou You Road, City, will convene a meeting of committee members and representatives of local labour unions for 2 p.m. February 3 in a room which will be registered under the name of Ling Tseng Kee (林振記), in the Dah Joo (大沪) Hotel, 345 Avenue Edward VII, French Concession, with a view to discussing means to oppose the change of name of the General Labour Union as instructed by the Ministry of Industry.

Shanghai Tug & Lighter Co. - crews demand annual bonus

At 10.30 a.m. January 31, two Chinese claiming to represent the crews of the Shanghai Tug & Lighter Co. called on the management at the office of the Company, 2 Quai de France, and asked for the issue of an annual bonus of one month's wages. This demand was rejected by the management on the ground that no such bonus had ever been issued and that owing to business depression the Company could not afford the bonus. The representatives then left.
page_data.zh:
情报报告
劳工（2）1934年2月1日。

华界银楼——“太公”罢工持续

2月1日上午，南市和闸北各银楼的“太公”罢工局势保持不变。
1月30日晚，“太公”罢工委员会组织的调查队约八名成员进入位于南市仁庙路和灵英路的孙炳记（Sung Fing Kee）和王荣才（Wong Yung Zai）银楼，砸毁了一些家具，理由是声称这些商号的学徒在秘密开工。虽请求中国警察协助，但入侵者在中国警察到达现场前已逃离。
1月31日下午1时30分至3时之间，“太公”罢工委员会六名成员在市内芝罘路59号银业公会举行会议，并通过以下决议：
1. 进一步请求当地国民党及社会局促成纠纷的圆满解决。
2. 通知所有会员在“太公”罢工期间留驻上海。
3. 警告孙炳记和王荣才两家商号不得再试图破坏“太公”罢工，并须对公会遭受的损失负责。

上海船坞工程公司——浦东机器厂与造船厂——不安情绪消除

应上海船坞工程公司浦东机器厂与造船厂工人的请求，社会局代表、总工会代表以及浦东第五区造船业工会代表，于1月31日上午与管理层代表就续签雇员服务条款协议一事进行谈判（参见1934年1月19日情报报告）。最终决定，除有关增加工资的条款外，现行协议延续一年。管理层认为，在业务好转之前，无法给雇员增加工资。

总工会——召集本地各工会代表开会——反对改名

位于市内豆油路117号的总工会，将于2月3日下午2时，在法租界爱德华七世路345号大沪酒店（Dah Joo Hotel）一个以林振记（Ling Tseng Kee）名义登记的房间内，召集委员及本地各工会代表举行会议，旨在讨论如何反对实业部指令的总工会改名事宜。

上海拖轮驳船公司——船员要求年终奖金

1月31日上午10时30分，两名自称代表上海拖轮驳船公司船员的华人前往该公司位于法兰西外滩2号的办公室拜会管理层，要求发放相当于一个月工资的年终奖金。管理层以从未发放过此类奖金，且因业务萧条公司无力负担为由，拒绝了这一要求。随后代表们离去。

page_data.en:
Labour (3) February 1, 1934.

Dah Chung Hwa Rubber Factory - ex-workers appeal to Bureau
of Social Affairs

At 2.15 p.m. January 31, nine ex-workers of the Dah Chung Hwa
Rubber Factory, 1102 Route de Ziccawei, proceeded to the Bureau of
Social Affairs at the New Civic Centre, and appealed to the
authorities for assistance in securing re-employment in the concern.
In reply, a staff member who received them stated that efforts would
be made to bring about a settlement. It will be recalled that
these unemployed workers were arrested by the French Police for
intimidation on January 28 and were released by the Court on
January 29.

Indo-China Steam Navigation Company - tallymen
on s.s. "Suiwo" declare strike

With a view to enforcing a demand for the reinstatement of one
of their comrades named Yih Soong-tsing ( 葉松春 ), who was dismissed
in December 1933, eleven tallymen employed on the Indo-China Steam
Navigation Company s.s. "Suiwo" declared a "tai-kung" strike when
the vessel arrived at Hunts Wharf at 6 p.m. on January 31. The
unloading of the vessel was carried out with the assistance of the
godown tallymen. The "tai-kung" strike still continues this morning.

Heng Foong Silk Weaving Factory

The 92 workers of the Heng Foong Silk Weaving Factory, Lane
464 Nos. 42/58 Yulin Road, who declared a strike on January 30 to
enforce a demand for restoration of their former rate of pay
(Vide I.R. 31/1/34), resumed unconditionally at 3 p.m. January 31,
as a result of mediation by the Bureau of Social Affairs.
These workers however did not turn up this morning, February 1.
The first day of a month is usually observed as a holiday but the
management notified its employees on January 31 to work as usual.
It is believed that their absence is instigated by several agitators.

Candle Makers' Union - meeting

Some 10 committee members of the above mentioned Union held a
meeting in their office, 3 Zao Chow Road, Nantao, between 2 p.m. and
3.30 p.m. January 31, when the following decisions were passed :-
1. That two representatives be assigned to call on the local
Kuomintang and the Bureau of Social Affairs on February 1 and
request the authorities to intercede on behalf of the workers
in connection with their demands for an increase in wages and
the conclusion of a labour agreement.
2. That local Kuomintang be further requested to instruct the
employers in the trade to refrain from dismissing workers on
the approach of the Chinese New Year.
page_data.zh:
劳工（3）1934年2月1日。

大中华橡胶厂——前工人向社会局申诉

1月31日下午2时15分，九名原籍霞飞路1102号大中华橡胶厂的前往新市中心的社会局，向当局求助，希望能在这家公司重新就业。接待他们的一名职员答复称，将努力促成解决。需指出的是，这些失业工人曾于1月28日因恐吓罪被法国警察逮捕，并于1月29日由法庭释放。

印度支那轮船公司——“绥沃”轮理货员宣布罢工

为了强制执行恢复其一名于1933年12月被解雇的同事叶松春（Yih Soong-tsing）职务的要求，受雇于印度支那轮船公司“绥沃”轮（s.s. "Suiwo"）的十一名理货员，在该轮于1月31日下午6时抵达亨特码头（Hunts Wharf）时，宣布举行“太公”罢工。该轮的卸货工作是在仓库理货员的协助下进行的。“太公”罢工至今晨仍在继续。

恒丰丝织厂

玉林路464弄42-58号恒丰丝织厂的92名工人，为强制要求恢复原有工资率而于1月30日宣布罢工（参见1934年1月31日情报报告），经社会局调解，已于1月31日下午3时无条件复工。
然而，这些工人今晨（2月1日）并未出勤。每月的第一天通常被视为假日，但管理层已于1月31日通知员工照常上班。据信，他们的缺席是由几名煽动者唆使所致。

制烛业公会——会议

上述公会约十名委员于1月31日下午2时至3时30分之间，在南市灶间路3号的公会办公室举行会议，会上通过以下决定：
1. 指派两名代表于2月1日拜会当地国民党及社会局，请求当局就工人要求增加工资及签订劳工协议一事进行干预。
2. 进一步请求当地国民党指示业内雇主在农历新年临近之际不要解雇工人。

February 1, 1934.

The wholesale price of Chinese Rice ranges from $6.60
to $7.80 per picul this morning and the retail prices quoted

1934 are as above.

New Weights and Measures - adopted by Customs

The local Chinese Maritime Customs issued a notice on
January 31 announcing that new weights and measures would be
adopted by the Customs beginning from February 1.

Rent Reduction Movement

Sixteen members of the 8th Branch of the 2nd Special
District Citizens' Federation held a meeting in their office,
9 Shun Teh Li ( 順德里 ), Rue Pere Robert, between 4 p.m.
and 6.15 p.m. January 31, when the following resolutions were
passed :-
1. That the French Concession Chinese Ratepayers' Association
and the 2nd Special District Citizens' Federation be
requested to ask the French Municipal Authorities to
prohibit the operation of dog-racing and Hai Alai in
the Concession and that a circular be issued exhorting
Chinese to refrain from attending such gambling places.
2. That a rent reduction committee be formed to conduct the rent
reduction movement in the district covered by the Branch.
3. That in connection with the dispute over rent between the
landlord and tenants of Sing Nyi Faung ( 新義坊 ), Rue
Bourgeat, in which the former decided to impose and increase
of 10%, while the latter are demanding a reduction of 20%,
the tenants in question be notified to stop payment of
rent to the landlord but deposit same according to the
present rate in banks pending a settlement of the dispute.

Forty-eight members of Tao Teh Li ( 道德里 ) (Rue Kraetzer)
Section of the 3rd District Branch of the 2nd Special District
Citizens' Federation, 39 Avenue Foch, held a meeting in the
office of the 2nd Special District Citizens' Federation, 434
Rue Auguste Boppe, between 8.30 p.m. and 11.10 p.m. January 31.
Loh Ching-dz ( 陸清士 ), a committee member of the local
Kuomintang, who is a resident at 34 Tao Teh Li, Rue Kraetzer,
reported that he had an interview with the landlord Sung Suh-mei
( 沈叔眉 ), at his office at 74 Rue du Consulat, at 3 p.m.
January 30 and that the latter promised to reduce the rent of
each house by $5 a month. Discussion took place and it was
decided to demand a reduction of 40% and to collect $5 from
each house as a fund to carry out agitation for rent reduction.
The rent collecting agent is D.H. Benjamin & Co., 259 Kiangse
Road.

H.W. Robertson
Supt.
for Officer i/c Special Branch.

新度量衡——海关采用

当地中国海关于1月31日发布通告，宣布自2月1日起，海关将采用新的度量衡制度。

减租运动

第二特区市民联合会第八分部十六名成员，于1月31日下午4时至6时15分之间，在罗伯特神父路顺德里9号的分部办公室举行会议，会上通过以下决议：
1. 请求法租界华人纳税会及第二特区市民联合会，要求法公董局禁止在租界内经营赛狗和回力球，并发布通函劝告华人勿前往此类赌博场所。
2. 成立减租委员会，在该分部所辖区域内开展减租运动。
3. 关于布尔热路（Rue Bourgeat）新义坊（Sing Nyi Faung）房东与租户之间的租金纠纷，鉴于前者决定加收10%，而后者要求减租20%，现通知相关租户停止向房东支付租金，但在纠纷解决之前，按现行费率将租金存入银行。

第二特区市民联合会第三分部道德里（Tao Teh Li）（克雷策尔路/Rue Kraetzer）段四十八名成员，于1月31日晚8时30分至11时10分之间，在奥古斯特·博佩路434号第二特区市民联合会办公室举行会议。当地国民党委员、居住于克雷策尔路道德里34号的陆清士（Loh Ching-dz）报告称，他于1月30日下午3时在领事馆路74号的办公室采访了房东沈叔眉（Sung Suh-mei），后者承诺每月每栋房屋减租5元。经过讨论，决定要求减租40%，并向每栋房屋收取5元作为开展减租宣传活动的基金。收租代理人为江西路259号的D.H. Benjamin & Co.。

H.W. Robertson
警司
代特别处主管警官
